proto_frozen_api_compat.heading: Frozen ledr-proto API Compatibility
proto_frozen_api_compat.description: crates/ledr-proto の既存公開型とシグネチャは後方互換なく変更しない。
proto_frozen_api_compat.instructions: Does the Git diff introduce a backward-incompatible change to any existing public type, enum variant, struct field, trait, constant, IPC message schema, or function signature in crates/ledr-proto? Answer Yes only if the diff removes, renames, changes types or signatures of, or alters serialization compatibility of existing public API items in crates/ledr-proto. Answer No if the diff only adds backward-compatible items, updates comments or tests, or preserves all existing public contracts.

criteria.true_description: The Git diff modifies, renames, removes, or breaks serialization or signature compatibility of an existing public API item in crates/ledr-proto.
criteria.false_description: The Git diff preserves backward compatibility for all existing public types, traits, constants, IPC messages, and signatures in crates/ledr-proto, or only touches comments or tests.

two_lane_no_unbounded_channel.heading: Phase 1 Two-Lane Bounded Channel Boundary
two_lane_no_unbounded_channel.description: センサーから DaemonEngine への供給は TwoLaneSender（HIGH_PRIORITY_CHANNEL_CAPACITY = 1024 / TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_CAPACITY = 8192）直結とし、前段へ無制限チャネルを挟まない。
two_lane_no_unbounded_channel.instructions: Does the Git diff insert an unbounded channel (such as mpsc::unbounded_channel) upstream of TwoLaneSender, weaken or alter the bounded lane capacities (HIGH_PRIORITY_CHANNEL_CAPACITY = 1024 / TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_CAPACITY = 8192), or allow dropping high-priority lane events between the sensor and DaemonEngine? Answer Yes only if the diff introduces an unbounded queue, alters or weakens the bounded two-lane capacities (1024 / 8192), bypasses TwoLaneSender bounded backpressure, or permits high-priority lane drops. Answer No if direct bounded two-lane delivery and default capacities (1024 / 8192) remain intact or the diff is unrelated to event channel wiring or capacity constants.

criteria.true_description: The Git diff introduces an unbounded channel before TwoLaneSender, alters or weakens the bounded two-lane capacities (1024 / 8192), bypasses bounded backpressure, or drops high-priority lane events.
criteria.false_description: The Git diff preserves direct bounded TwoLaneSender delivery and the 1024 / 8192 lane capacities without an upstream unbounded queue, or does not affect sensor-to-engine channel wiring or lane capacity constants.

never_suspend_and_create_time.heading: Active Defense Never-Suspend and Process Identity Guard
never_suspend_and_create_time.description: NtSuspendProcess とプロセス終了の前に、is_never_suspend_process 判定と ProcessIdentity.create_time_100ns 一致を必ず検証する。
never_suspend_and_create_time.instructions: Does the Git diff invoke or wire NtSuspendProcess or process termination while omitting, bypassing, or weakening the is_never_suspend_process check, the ProcessIdentity.create_time_100ns match verification, or ProcessLiveness Unknown handling? Answer Yes only if the diff allows suspend or termination paths to skip is_never_suspend_process or create_time_100ns verification or treats Unknown liveness as Gone. Answer No if both guards remain enforced before suspend or terminate or the diff is unrelated to defense actuators.

criteria.true_description: The Git diff adds or modifies a suspend or termination path that skips, bypasses, or weakens is_never_suspend_process, create_time_100ns verification, or ProcessLiveness safety checks.
criteria.false_description: The Git diff enforces is_never_suspend_process and create_time_100ns verification on all suspend and termination paths, or does not alter process defense actuation.

canary_write_only_and_expired_suspended.heading: File Canary Write-Only Trigger and 60s ExpiredSuspended Transition
canary_write_only_and_expired_suspended.description: おとりファイルは書き込み・削除・リネームのみで発火させ読み取りで発火させず、未応答 60 秒到達時は EXPIRED_SUSPENDED（AlertStatus::ExpiredSuspended）へ遷移させて自動再開しない。
canary_write_only_and_expired_suspended.instructions: Does the Git diff cause honeypot or canary triggers to fire on file read operations, alter the 60-second unanswered alert timeout default (DEFAULT_ALERT_TIMEOUT_SECS = 60 / alert_timeout_ms), omit or disable transitioning overdue pending alerts to EXPIRED_SUSPENDED (AlertStatus::ExpiredSuspended), or automatically resume or terminate suspended processes on timeout? Answer Yes if the diff triggers canary alerts on reads, changes the 60-second timeout default, removes or skips the EXPIRED_SUSPENDED transition on expiry, or introduces automatic process resumption or termination on alert timeout. Answer No if canary detection stays restricted to write, delete, and rename events, the 60-second timeout default and EXPIRED_SUSPENDED transition remain enforced without auto-resume or auto-kill, or the diff is unrelated.

criteria.true_description: The Git diff triggers file canary alerts on read access, changes the 60-second unanswered alert timeout default, omits or disables the EXPIRED_SUSPENDED transition for overdue alerts, or automatically resumes or terminates suspended processes upon timeout.
criteria.false_description: The Git diff restricts canary triggers to write, delete, and rename events and preserves both the 60-second timeout default and the EXPIRED_SUSPENDED transition without auto-resume or auto-kill, or is unrelated.

session0_non_system_and_ui_zero_exit.heading: Session 0 Non-SYSTEM UI Launch and Zero Resident Process on Close
session0_non_system_and_ui_zero_exit.description: --notify 起動は WTSQueryUserToken と CreateProcessAsUser で非 SYSTEM ユーザー権限を用い、ウィンドウ閉鎖時は ledr-ui と関連 WebView2 プロセスを 0 件にする。
session0_non_system_and_ui_zero_exit.instructions: Does the Git diff launch ledr-ui --notify under SYSTEM privileges instead of non-SYSTEM user impersonation via WTSQueryUserToken and CreateProcessAsUser, or keep ledr-ui or WebView2 processes resident in a tray or background after window close? Answer Yes only if the diff removes or bypasses non-SYSTEM user token launch for Session 0 notifications or introduces tray or background persistence that prevents zero processes on UI close. Answer No if non-SYSTEM token launch and zero-process exit remain preserved.

criteria.true_description: The Git diff spawns UI notifications as SYSTEM, bypasses WTSQueryUserToken or CreateProcessAsUser, or leaves ledr-ui or WebView2 resident after closing the window.
criteria.false_description: The Git diff maintains non-SYSTEM user token UI launch for Session 0 notifications and clean full exit to zero processes on window close, or is unrelated.

ipc_caller_auth_and_rw_timeout.heading: Named Pipe IPC Caller Authorization and Read/Write Timeouts
ipc_caller_auth_and_rw_timeout.description: 状態変更要求および ReportDownloadOrigin と ReportBrowserEvent 等の監査報告要求は開発バイパス無効時に GetNamedPipeClientProcessId で正規バイナリを検証し、読み書き双方へタイムアウトを設定する。
ipc_caller_auth_and_rw_timeout.instructions: Does the Git diff add or modify an IPC state-changing or audit-reporting handler (such as ReportDownloadOrigin or ReportBrowserEvent) that omits GetNamedPipeClientProcessId caller binary verification (AUTHORIZED_UI_EXE_PATH or AUTHORIZED_BRIDGE_EXE_PATH) when dev_bypass_auth is disabled, or omit read, write, or flush timeouts on IPC pipe I/O? Answer Yes only if caller authentication is skipped outside dev_bypass_auth or IPC I/O lacks bounded read, write, or flush timeouts. Answer No if caller authorization and bounded read/write/flush timeouts are enforced.

criteria.true_description: The Git diff omits GetNamedPipeClientProcessId caller authorization on state-changing or audit-reporting IPC requests when dev_bypass_auth is false, or leaves IPC read, write, or flush operations without timeouts.
criteria.false_description: The Git diff enforces GetNamedPipeClientProcessId binary verification for non-bypass builds and applies explicit read, write, and flush timeouts across IPC handlers.

wfp_dynamic_session_and_deny_priority.heading: WFP Dynamic Session, Partial Failure Rollback, and Shared-IP Deny Priority
wfp_dynamic_session_and_deny_priority.description: WFP エンジンは FWPM_SESSION_FLAG_DYNAMIC と独自 SubLayer を使い、片系失敗時の復元と共有 IP の deny-overrides-allow およびデュアルスタック鮮度検証を維持する。
wfp_dynamic_session_and_deny_priority.instructions: Does the Git diff remove FWPM_SESSION_FLAG_DYNAMIC or the dedicated LocalEDR SubLayer (risking persistent kernel filters after crash), skip rollback or compensation when suspend or WFP filter reconciliation partially fails, violate deny-overrides-allow across shared IPs, or weaken dual-stack DNS freshness (independent IPv4/IPv6 timestamp tracking that prevents delayed responses from regressing newer records)? Answer Yes only if dynamic session or SubLayer guarantees, partial-failure rollback, shared-IP deny priority, or dual-stack DNS freshness checks are broken. Answer No if dynamic WFP session flags, SubLayer scoping, partial-failure rollback, deny-overrides-allow priority, and dual-stack DNS freshness remain intact, or the diff is unrelated.

criteria.true_description: The Git diff drops FWPM_SESSION_FLAG_DYNAMIC or dedicated SubLayer usage, leaves orphaned state on partial suspend or WFP failure, weakens shared-IP deny-overrides-allow, or breaks independent IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack DNS freshness checks.
criteria.false_description: The Git diff preserves FWPM_SESSION_FLAG_DYNAMIC, dedicated SubLayer, compensation rollback on partial failure, deny-overrides-allow priority, and independent IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack DNS freshness checks, or is unrelated.

nrd_shutdown_nonblocking_and_checkpoint.heading: Phase 3 Non-Blocking NRD Shutdown, Checkpoint Priority, and Chunked Cancel
nrd_shutdown_nonblocking_and_checkpoint.description: NRD 更新スレッド停止は spawn_blocking を使わず NrdThreadHandle（oneshot と InFlightGuard::drop）で非ブロッキング待機し、checkpoint_truncate 優先と 64 KiB チャンク単位キャンセルを維持する。
nrd_shutdown_nonblocking_and_checkpoint.instructions: Does the Git diff introduce tokio::task::spawn_blocking to join the NRD worker thread, skip prioritizing checkpoint_truncate before waiting on NRD shutdown, raise the NRD file read chunk size limit above 64 KiB (NRD_FILE_READ_CHUNK_BYTES = 64 * 1024), or remove per-chunk cancellation checks (including before ErrorKind::Interrupted retries) in bounded NRD file or stream readers? Answer Yes only if blocking join via spawn_blocking is introduced, checkpoint priority on shutdown is removed, the 64 KiB read chunk limit is increased, or chunked cancellation checks are bypassed. Answer No if non-blocking oneshot/InFlightGuard shutdown, checkpoint priority, the 64 KiB chunk limit, and cancellable chunk reads remain intact, or the diff is unrelated.

criteria.true_description: The Git diff introduces spawn_blocking for NRD thread join, omits shutdown checkpoint priority before waiting, raises the NRD read chunk size limit above 64 KiB (NRD_FILE_READ_CHUNK_BYTES), or removes bounded chunk cancellation checks around reads or Interrupted retries.
criteria.false_description: The Git diff preserves non-blocking NrdThreadHandle shutdown, checkpoint_truncate priority, the 64 KiB maximum read chunk size (NRD_FILE_READ_CHUNK_BYTES), and per-chunk cancellation checks, or does not touch NRD lifecycle or reader logic.

phase4_nrd_local_only_and_motw.heading: Phase 4 Local-Only NRD Evaluation and 3-Stage MOTW Lineage
phase4_nrd_local_only_and_motw.description: Phase 4 の NRD 判定は閲覧ドメインを外部送信せずローカル完結に保ち、ダウンロード起源はパス・SHA-256・:Zone.Identifier の 3 段階で紐付ける。
phase4_nrd_local_only_and_motw.instructions: Does the Git diff transmit visited browser domains or URLs to an external remote service for NRD or phishing lookups, or omit any of the three required MOTW download-origin correlation stages (file path, SHA-256 hash, and :Zone.Identifier alternate data stream)? Answer Yes only if the diff sends browsed domains externally or weakens the three-stage MOTW correlation (path, SHA-256, and :Zone.Identifier). Answer No if NRD lookups stay strictly local and all three MOTW correlation stages are preserved or unmodified.

criteria.true_description: The Git diff sends visited domains or URLs to an external endpoint during NRD evaluation, or omits path, SHA-256, or :Zone.Identifier correlation in MOTW handling.
criteria.false_description: The Git diff keeps NRD and homograph evaluation strictly local without external domain leakage and preserves three-stage MOTW correlation, or is unrelated.

phase4_clickfix_l15_guard.heading: Decision Record L-15 ClickFix / Pastejacking Trigger Guard
phase4_clickfix_l15_guard.description: 決定記録 L-15 に従い、ClickFix 警告発火は危険な LOTL コマンド特徴量または DOM getSelection() とクリップボード書き込み内容の不一致に限定し、通常コピーを誤警告しない。
phase4_clickfix_l15_guard.instructions: Does the Git diff broaden ClickFix or Pastejacking warning triggers beyond dangerous LOTL command indicators or a mismatch between DOM getSelection() and clipboard write contents (Decision Record L-15), causing false alarms on ordinary developer code copies? Answer Yes only if copy or clipboard interception triggers alerts on benign copies lacking LOTL indicators and selection-clipboard mismatch. Answer No if triggers remain gated by LOTL features or getSelection() mismatch or the diff does not modify ClickFix detection.

criteria.true_description: The Git diff triggers ClickFix warnings broadly on normal copy operations without requiring dangerous LOTL command indicators or a getSelection() versus clipboard mismatch.
criteria.false_description: The Git diff restricts ClickFix warning triggers to LOTL command indicators or DOM getSelection() versus clipboard content mismatches per Decision Record L-15, or is unrelated.
